description: Excerpt-fidelity questions for the described-query class. One record per described-NN query in queries.json, same id. answer_span is the verbatim string the excerpt must carry; reference_fact locates the gold pages.

questions.question: does normalizing layer inputs converge in fewer training steps at equal accuracy
questions.reference_fact: achieves the same accuracy with 14 times fewer training steps, and beats the original model
questions.answer_span: 14 times fewer training steps

questions.question: what error rates were reached on the two small image benchmarks
questions.reference_fact: we demonstrate new state-of-the-art results at 3.14% and 16.21%, respectively

questions.question: do weight decay and dropout prevent networks from memorising randomly assigned labels
questions.reference_fact: This phenomenon is qualitatively unaffected by explicit regularization
questions.answer_span: qualitatively unaffected by explicit regularization

questions.question: how does required model size grow as the training collection expands
questions.reference_fact: We also show that model size scales sublinearly with data size
questions.answer_span: model size scales sublinearly with data size

questions.question: what proportion of the original network do the trainable subnetworks occupy
questions.reference_fact: winning tickets that are less than 10-20% of the size of several fully-connected and convolutional feed-forward architectures
questions.answer_span: less than 10-20% of the size

questions.question: what top-one accuracy does the largest scaled convolutional model reach
questions.reference_fact: achieves state-of-the-art 84.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet, while being 8.4x smaller
questions.answer_span: 84.3% top-1 accuracy

questions.question: can adding more training examples ever hurt performance at test time
questions.reference_fact: increasing (even quadrupling) the number of train samples actually hurts test performance
questions.answer_span: actually hurts test performance

questions.question: does generalization improve long after the training set is fully fitted
questions.reference_fact: improving generalization performance from random chance level to perfect generalization
questions.answer_span: from random chance level to perfect generalization

questions.question: how should tokens and parameters be traded off under a fixed compute budget
questions.reference_fact: the model size and the number of training tokens should be scaled equally: for every doubling of model size the number of training tokens should also be doubled
questions.answer_span: for every doubling of model size the number of training tokens should also be doubled

questions.question: how much wall-clock speedup was measured on the mid-sized language model
questions.reference_fact: 3× speedup on GPT-2 (seq. length 1K), and 2.4× speedup on long-range arena
questions.answer_span: 3× speedup on GPT-2

questions.question: what makes a capability count as emergent rather than predictable
questions.reference_fact: We consider an ability to be emergent if it is not present in smaller models but is present in larger models
questions.answer_span: not present in smaller models but is present in larger models

questions.question: how much higher is inference throughput than a comparable transformer
questions.reference_fact: Mamba enjoys fast inference (5× higher throughput than Transformers) and linear scaling in sequence length
questions.answer_span: 5× higher throughput than Transformers

questions.question: how much pre-training time is saved at the largest evaluated scale
questions.reference_fact: TST yields up to a 2.5x reduction in total pre-training time at the 10B A1B scale
questions.answer_span: 2.5x reduction in total pre-training time

questions.question: can images be classified without convolutions by treating regions as tokens
questions.reference_fact: We show that this reliance on CNNs is not necessary and a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches
questions.answer_span: a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches

questions.question: what functional form describes how loss falls as compute grows
questions.reference_fact: model size and compute budgets increase, following a power-law plus constant scaling law
questions.answer_span: a power-law plus constant scaling law

questions.question: how many weights does the model have and how does that compare to earlier dense models
questions.reference_fact: an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
questions.answer_span: 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model

questions.question: which collection was used to show binary networks stay competitive
questions.reference_fact: We test the proposed network on the MNIST dataset, represented using binary features
questions.answer_span: the MNIST dataset, represented using binary features

questions.question: how large was the news archive the topic model was demonstrated on
questions.reference_fact: We demonstrate our algorithm on 1.8 million documents from The New York Times
questions.answer_span: 1.8 million documents from The New York Times

questions.question: how many companies are covered by the equities data used for qualitative evaluation
questions.reference_fact: a set of 39 million stock returns divided across roughly 6,500 companies from the years 1962

questions.question: what convergence guarantee is proved for the momentum based sparse solver

questions.reference_fact: incurs an SNR penalty of about 2 dB at low to medium SNRs
